Furthermore, its Return on Equity reaches an impressive 23.15%, easily surpassing the sector benchmark of 11.39% [E8]. Market momentum remains robust, with the stock sitting comfortably at 89% of the way up its 52-week range between a low of 1,130 and a high of 1,674 [E4]. Additionally, shareholders receive no income for holding this highly-priced stock, as the dividend yield stands at 0.00% [E3].
